MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

2. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 1

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 40

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

7. Solve for x: x + 6 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 6

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

11. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 1
   D. 12

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
